name: Nakama
source:
Nakama is an avid user of the internet, and like Furuya she believes it has the power to connect people. [Spoiler]She believes that Furuya is special, and joins him with the goal to surpass Kamui.[/spoiler] 

[Edited from the [url=https://killthepastwiki.com/Nakama]Wiki[/url]]
